title: Registration and Treatment of Pain During Eye Examination of Prematurity
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to see if paracetamol has a pain-relieving effect during eye examination in premature infants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants \< 32 weeks of gestational age (\< 31+6 weeks)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Infants with ongoing analgesic treatment
